name: Dosu
summary: Hosted AI service that turns a codebase, pull requests, issues and conversations into maintained documentation, with a GitHub app (dosubot) that replies to new issues in repositories that enable it. Hosted MCP server and REST API take OAuth 2.0 or an API key. Counted 2026-11-11: in langgenius/dify the bot replied to 31 of the first 47 October 2026 issues, all within 2.5 minutes; in apache/superset it commented on 5 of 150.

payments.notes: Pricing page read 2026-11-11: Free, 200 credits per month, public repositories only; Pro "$16 /month ($192 billed upfront)", 4000 credits; Enterprise custom. Payment method not read. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: MCP at api.dosu.dev/v1/mcp: keyless initialize answered 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge (2026-11-11). OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration and PKCE S256, or an API key from account settings. The vendor documents self-serve agent sign-up; a person still installs the GitHub app.

jobs.summary: Replies to new GitHub issues and, per its case studies, flags likely duplicates; hosted auto-labeling ended (now an open-source Action). Time to first response counted here: under 2.5 min in a Dify sample; share of issues answered varies by repo. Triage accuracy and duplicates caught unmeasured.
